# Overview

This project parses Alma Analytics `.catalog` files to extract and document OBIEE metadata.

## Test R Code

```{r}
x <- 1:10
mean(x)
```
```{r}
source("scripts/parse_catalog.R")

results <- parse_catalog(
  "data/sample.catalog"
)

head(results)
```
